title: Tempered
summary: Haldor says a blade isn't finished until it's held something. A fighter of yours should hold the Assay's counting house, ten waves, and not give an inch.

steps.journal: The Assay Yards: the counting house, the first floor's hall. Hold it ten waves.

objectives.label: Waves held in the counting house

ready: The counting house held ten waves. Go back to Haldor at the Ashgate Forge.
done: Haldor says your fighters are tempered. He says it to the blade.
